newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy fund managers want more STET/Telecom details.
newsitem.headline: Italy fund managers want more STET/Telecom details.

text.p: Italy's association of fund managers Assogestioni want to see more information over the planned merger of state-controlled telecoms holding company STET with Telecom Italia.
A statement from the association said it had asked Italian stock market authority Consob to intervene and demand more information for investors over the merger.
The association said it supported the merger between the two groups, but said there was inadequate information about the deal for investors.
Earlier this week, the Italian Treasury announced the planned merger and added that the full flotation of STET would be delayed until late 1997.
